messages:
maria: Hey team — CI is red on PR #5423 after merging main. pre-commit / pyright failing and it's blocking the merge. cc @lee @sanjay

ci-bot: Build 8743 failed on commit abc123: pre-commit hook 'pyright' reported 3 errors. logs: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/8743

lee: Can you paste the pyright output? quick glance might help.

maria: Sure, pasted below:
```
src/redwood/runtime/cache.py:42: error: Expression of type "None | str" cannot be assigned to declared type "str"
  return self._prefix
src/redwood/runtime/cache.py:56: error: Argument 1 to "join" has incompatible type "Optional[str]"; expected "str"
```
Locally pyright v1.3 passes for me. Fails in CI which uses pre-commit pinned versions.

sanjay: Hm. That looks like a stricter check in pyright 1.4. Did we bump pyright in pre-commit recently? @devex

maria: I ran `pre-commit run pyright --all-files` and it fails when I update to pyright v1.4 locally.

lee: If it's a new pyright, quick options: pin pre-commit to 1.3 or add a small typing fix. E.g. `return cast(str, self._prefix)` or handle Optional properly. Fixing types is probably cleaner.

maria: Agree. If it's a small change and safe I'll take the fix. Also we need to update .pre-commit-config.yaml lockfile if we change versions. Don't want CI to flip-flop.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by lee — queued.

devex: FYI we did merge a pre-commit update in #5401 that bumped pyright to 1.4 in main. We plan to roll back in staging to reduce noise while teams update code.

sanjay: OK. If @lee or @maria open a PR, ping @eng so reviewers can prioritize (this is a merge-blocker).

maria: Thanks — will watch for @lee's PR. :thumbsup:
